```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, tximport)
```


#Preparing Data
```{r}
# Read in kallisto abundance files of the 3 control proliferating A1 samples (0h)
dir <- "A1_cross_species_comparisons/top_tpm_A1/kallisto_quant_MT_katia"

files <- file.path(dir, c("Ctrl_0h_1_ Abundances (tabular).tabular",
                          "Ctrl_0h_2_ Abundances (tabular).tabular",
                          "Ctrl_0h_3_ Abundances (tabular).tabular"))

tx2gene <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "tx2gene_nvir_katia.csv"))

txi.kallisto <- tximport(files,
                         type = "kallisto",
                         tx2gene = tx2gene)

abundance <- txi.kallisto$abundance # Extract TPM
```


#Median GEX
```{r}
# Katia Del-Rio Tsonis Lab transcriptome annotations
annotations <- read.csv("Nvir_Annotations/Nvir Latest Annotation Katia/Nvir_annotations_MT_Katia_final.csv", header = TRUE)

# Calculate median TPM values for every gene across replicates => more resistant to outliers
median_tpm <- data.frame(GENEID = rownames(abundance),
                         median_tpm = matrixStats::rowMedians(abundance))

median_tpm <- median_tpm %>%
  left_join(annotations, by = "GENEID") %>%
  arrange(desc(median_tpm)) %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% # Keep the most expressed gene of each symbol
  mutate(median_tpm = round(median_tpm, 2)) %>%
  mutate(logmedian = round(log2(median_tpm + 1), 2)) %>% # Log-transform
  mutate(median_tpm = round(median_tpm)) %>% # Whole TPM, used to sort the bars
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL, median_tpm, logmedian)

# Myf5, Myog and Myf6 are missing from this annotation: their values come from the Sandberg transcriptome (made in top_tpm_A1_Sandberg)
sandberg_myogenesis <- read.csv("A1_cross_species_comparisons/top_tpm_A1_Sandberg/Myogenesis_genes_Sandberg.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL, median_tpm, logmedian)

median_tpm <- bind_rows(median_tpm, sandberg_myogenesis)
```


#Cell Type Markers
```{r}
# Marker genes of each cell type, with their symbols in the newt annotation. Myod1 is not in it
smooth_muscle <- c("TAGLN", "ACTA2", "Cald1", "des", "Aebp1.3", "MYOCD", "MYH11.2", "MYH9.3", "Myh9.4", "CCN1", "PALLD", "MYL9.1", "CNN1", "TPM2", "tpm1.3", "Tagln2.3", "Mcam", "TINAGL1", "FLNA.4", "Myf6")
fibroblast <- c("Col5a2.2", "Loxl1", "Pdgfra", "FBLN1.1", "LUM.1", "DPT", "HSD11B1.1", "CD34", "FBLN1.2", "Fbln2")
mixed <- c("COL1A2", "COL1A1.2", "TIMP2", "Col12a1.2", "COL6A2.4", "VIM.1", "fn1", "COL5A1.2", "RGS4", "MGST3", "CCN2")
myoblast <- c("pax3", "Pax7", "Myf5", "Myog")

marker_tpm <- median_tpm %>%
  dplyr::filter(SYMBOL %in% c(smooth_muscle, fibroblast, mixed, myoblast)) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = case_when(SYMBOL %in% smooth_muscle ~ "Smooth Muscle",
                               SYMBOL %in% fibroblast ~ "Fibroblast",
                               SYMBOL %in% mixed ~ "Mixed",
                               SYMBOL %in% myoblast ~ "Myoblast")) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("Smooth Muscle", "Fibroblast", "Mixed", "Myoblast"))) %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL = str_to_sentence(SYMBOL)) %>% # Mouse-style symbols, e.g. TAGLN -> Tagln
  arrange(cell_type, desc(median_tpm)) %>% # Most expressed genes first within each cell type
  mutate(SYMBOL = factor(SYMBOL, levels = unique(SYMBOL))) # Keep this order on the x axis
```


#Fig. 1D and Supplementary Fig. 2B
```{r}
# Fig. 1D and Supplementary Fig. 2B: log2 median TPM of the cell type markers in A1 cells
# Gene labels stand upright above the bars. A label that would touch the one on its left is lifted above it and joined to its bar by a thin line
marker_tpm$label_len <- nchar(as.character(marker_tpm$SYMBOL)) * 0.2 # Approximate label length in y units

marker_tpm$label_y <- marker_tpm$logmedian + 0.15

for (i in 2:nrow(marker_tpm)) {
  left_top <- marker_tpm$label_y[i - 1] + marker_tpm$label_len[i - 1] + 0.25 # Top of the label on the left, plus a gap
  touch <- marker_tpm$label_y[i] < left_top &
    marker_tpm$label_y[i - 1] < marker_tpm$label_y[i] + marker_tpm$label_len[i] + 0.25
  if (touch) marker_tpm$label_y[i] <- left_top
}

color_palette <- c("Smooth Muscle" = "#F8766D",
                   "Fibroblast" = "#00BFC4",
                   "Mixed" = "#7CAE00",
                   "Myoblast" = "#C77CFF")

tpm_plot <- ggplot(marker_tpm, aes(x = SYMBOL, y = logmedian, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(3.32, 9.97), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30") + # 10 and 1000 TPM
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = as.numeric(SYMBOL) - 0.5, xmax = as.numeric(SYMBOL) + 0.35, ymin = label_y, ymax = label_y + label_len),
            fill = "white", inherit.aes = FALSE) + # White behind each label, so that the dashed lines stop at the labels
  geom_segment(data = dplyr::filter(marker_tpm, label_y > logmedian + 0.2),
               aes(xend = SYMBOL, y = logmedian + 0.05, yend = label_y - 0.05),
               linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey40") + # Line from a lifted label to its bar
  geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = SYMBOL), angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.4, size = 6.5 / .pt) + # 6.5 pt gene labels, centred on the letters including descenders
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.9, 0.8))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15), breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 3), expand = c(0, 0), # Same y axis in all panels, with room for the lifted labels
                     sec.axis = dup_axis(breaks = c(3.32, 9.97), labels = c("10 TPM", "1000 TPM"), name = NULL)) + # Name the dashed lines
  labs(title = "A1 (bulk, 3 samples)",
       x = "Gene symbol",
       y = "Log2 median TPM") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), # Remove x-axis labels
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, colour = "red3"), # Labels of the dashed lines
        axis.line.y.right = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(1.5, "mm"))

tpm_plot

ggsave(filename = "A1_cross_species_comparisons/top_tpm_A1/Log2 Median TPM A1 Samples_v2.png", plot = tpm_plot, width = 102, height = 123, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white") # Fig. 1D
ggsave(filename = "A1_cross_species_comparisons/top_tpm_A1/Log2 Median TPM A1 Samples_Supp_v2.png", plot = tpm_plot, width = 99, height = 114, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white") # Supplementary Fig. 2B
```
